caption: The drawing consists of a single cylindrical mug with a handle, rendered in pencil on an off-white, slightly yellowed paper. The mug is centered within a rectangular border, with detailed shading that gives it a metallic appearance. It has a rounded base with two horizontal bands near the bottom and another near the rim. The handle is attached on one side and features a slight curl at the bottom. Above the mug is a monogram composed of three decorative, overlapping script letters done in pencil, while in the lower right corner, there is a small signature. In the lower left corner of the main rectangle, there is an additional smaller sketch showing a simplified front view of the mug and its handle within a square border. The entire composition is monochromatic, consisting only of pencil lines and shading with no added colors.
title: Silver Mug
